predecessor_evidence: reports/research/LEDGER.md E-005/E-006: cross-sectional price rank is beta-free but the measured effect is below the cost drag in both directions

dataset.feature: taker_buy_quote_asset_volume / quote_asset_volume per closed bar, from the verified tape payload
dataset.alignment_rule: one shared bar grid and a measured share on every leg; a bar with a missing share is skipped for the whole cross-section

execution_model.entry: MARKET at the next bar open after a symbol newly enters an extreme aggressive-flow rank
execution_model.exit: static bracket, stop 2% / target 4% of entry, stop-first intrabar, 48-bar time exit
execution_model.funding: actual venue settlements inside the holding window
execution_model.sizing: risk 100 USDT per leg; R = net PnL / 100

candidates.statement: Aggressive taker-buy pressure carries directional information at the one-hour horizon: the two symbols with the highest aggressive-buy share outperform the two with the lowest by more than the round-trip cost and more than a random two-and-two selection at the same bars.
candidates.direction_rule: LONG the two highest taker-buy-share symbols, SHORT the two lowest
candidates.event_rule: trade only when a symbol newly enters an extreme rank
candidates.falsified_by: net expectancy <= 0, or not above the matched random selection, or concentration in fewer than 6 of 10 symbols

matched_random_selection.pool: at each treatment event bar, two random longs and two random shorts from the same ten symbols, identical bracket, costs, funding and time exit
matched_random_selection.p_value: one-sided Monte Carlo: (1 + draws at least as good) / (1 + draws)
matched_random_selection.draws_rationale: flow ranks change on almost every bar, so the control reprices ~4 legs per event per draw; 50 draws bounds the run while keeping a 2% granularity p-value floor

unit_of_comparison: per-leg net R; cross-market clustering unit is the per-symbol mean net R

gates.multiple_testing: Holm over the hypotheses in this family (one primary)

decision_rule: DEV_CANDIDATE only when every gate passes; otherwise NO_EDGE. A DEV_CANDIDATE is frozen and then evaluated on the sealed holdout exactly once. PASS can never be awarded by this screen.

cumulative_dev_budget.note: Development is exploratory; the holdout has not been read.

known_limitations: taker-buy share is inferred from the venue kline payload and is not a signed trade tape
legs overlap heavily because flow ranks change almost every bar; the pooled mean is an expectancy estimate, not an equity curve
shared-account competition and margin are not modelled by this screen
